executionCapabilities.title: CALA Brand Onboarding
executionCapabilities.description: Regional leadership coordinates franchise application, brand review, and opening checklists for DR, México, Turks & Caicos, and pipeline markets—backed by Hotel Equities enterprise relationships.

executionCapabilities.title: Standards & PIP Translation
executionCapabilities.description: Helps owners interpret brand standards, technical services, and capex implications during conversion and stabilized operations—critical for first-time franchised owners in CALA.

executionCapabilities.title: Conversion & Reflag Execution
executionCapabilities.description: Operating readiness, systems cutover, training, and guest-facing transition for assets moving independent-to-branded or between flags within Marriott, Hilton, and Hyatt families.

executionCapabilities.title: Brand–Owner–Franchisor Coordination
executionCapabilities.description: Single regional operating voice for ownership, brand development, and property teams—reduces friction during pipeline openings (Curaçao, Costa Rica, Trinidad & Tobago referenced publicly).

executionCapabilities.title: Soft-Brand & Collection Strategy
executionCapabilities.description: Supports Curio, Tribute, Autograph, LXR, and collection-style affiliations where owners need flexibility and story-driven positioning in leisure markets.

executionCapabilities.title: Independent-to-Branded Transition
executionCapabilities.description: Pre-conversion operating discipline for owner-led resorts before flag—aligned to HE CALA's public emphasis on conversions and repositioning.

governanceCompliance.title: Brand QA & Audit Readiness
governanceCompliance.description: QA preparation and recurring compliance tracking through standard branded-hotel operating practices; public sources do not publish a proprietary audit pass-rate band (Not Measured / N/A).

governanceCompliance.title: Technical Services & Opening Deliverables
governanceCompliance.description: Design, PIP, life safety, and brand-required deliverables coordinated with openings leadership for pipeline and newly opened CALA assets.

governanceCompliance.title: Brand Performance Reporting
governanceCompliance.description: Guest metrics, loyalty contribution, and standards action plans folded into monthly owner operating reviews where brand agreements require.

governanceCompliance.title: Owner Decision Support on Brand Trade-Offs
governanceCompliance.description: Clear explanation of franchise obligations, timing, and operational requirements before owners commit to a flag in CALA leisure markets.

brandRelationships.softIndependentNarrative: If you are evaluating soft-brand affiliation, an independent-to-branded conversion, or repositioning an independent resort in the Caribbean or Latin America, Hotel Equities CALA can help you interpret brand requirements, protect local identity, prepare operationally for a flag transition, and understand how Marriott, Hilton, or Hyatt distribution may affect your operating model.
